title: CV PC5 V3 PlantVillage Segmentation Holdout
subtitle: Curated PlantVillage leaf images for qualitative segmentation analysis
description: A curated PlantVillage subset prepared for Computer Vision Practice 5 segmentation analysis. The dataset contains seven visual review categories for qualitative holdout review: 10 images each for healthy leaves, small diseased regions, large diseased regions, simple backgrounds, complex backgrounds, and multiple leaves, plus 7 images for partial occlusions. Categories are heuristic and review-oriented, not segmentation ground truth.
